cross_references.relationship: sibling writ -- 1085 is traditional mandamus (ministerial duties, no discretion). 1094.5 is administrative mandamus (discretionary decisions after a hearing). The distinction between the two defines California writ practice.

frequently pleaded together -- 526a provides taxpayer standing to challenge illegal expenditures; 1085 compels performance of ministerial duties. When a government officer both spends illegally and refuses a legal duty, both statutes apply.

Tort Claims Act boundary -- mandamus is an equitable remedy, not a tort claim; the Government Claims Act (Gov. Code 810+) does not require a prior claim filing for writ petitions, but the two frameworks intersect when government conduct involves both a refusal to act and a tortious injury
